evaluation: All128 fresh IDs and128 inherited excluded IDs forbidden to sampler. Novel holdouts share honest feature extraction, phase handling and nil safeguards; their ordinary play mechanisms are separately implemented.
fresh_evaluation_policy: Seed labels and128 excluded IDs fixed before any training outcomes; functional fixtures are development-visible; no heldout playing-strength games used to choose opponents or variants.
information: Only actor hand via _novel_hand; public bids/tricks/scores/bags/table/played_by/played_at/voids. Blind only actor/eligible/scores/bags/bids, never any hand or legal_mask.

mechanisms.allocation_lower_bound_pressure: HELDOUT: use public suit-capacity lower bounds to pressure opponents forced to retain a suit, plus a distinct interval-based capture rule.
mechanisms.lexicographic_seat_safety: HELDOUT: lexicographic positional rule tree prioritizes nil safety, public secure capture, late-seat economy, and public-information exits.
mechanisms.long_suit_entry_links: Preserve sole outside entries to established long suits; run the long suit after blockers disappear, and use connected suit exits to retain access.
mechanisms.marginal_loser_disposal: Discard the card that most reduces residual own-hand exposure, including isolated honors, emptying suits, and retaining the last stopper.
mechanisms.marginal_round_score: Compare exact frozen-rule one-trick score deltas including coupled nil contracts and ten-bag rollover, with discounted future contract urgency.
mechanisms.nil_shelter_lanes: Allocate shelter leads to suits where public partner low-card expenditure and own high cover imply exposure; conserve one cover per exposed lane.
mechanisms.nil_underlead_pressure: Lead below an opposing live nil public rank floor and replay suits in which its low cards have been spent; duck its current winning card.
mechanisms.positional_overruff_ladder: Select overruff rungs using outstanding higher trump counts and actual future seat order, distinguishing last-seat economy from exposed intermediate ruffs.
mechanisms.public_partner_suit_return: Return suits actually led by partner using public played_at chronology, weighted by recency, repeated leads, and known voids.
mechanisms.public_scenario_regret: Minimize maximum regret across three explicit public threat scenarios (cheap capture, delayed overtake, resource preservation), without hidden deals.

preservation: All461 inherited valid IDs delegate captured tactical-v4 with same state/key/style. All128 old exclusions retained. No state, RNG, optimizer, outer mixture or current-match style reset.
strength: Unmeasured. CPU legality, privacy and behavioral diversity tests are not evidence of improved playing strength or blind-nil outcomes.
variant_design: 4x4x4 factorial: tempo changes positional/remaining-trick thresholds, resource changes suit-length and card-disposal preferences, risk changes bid/cover/blind thresholds. No old-family modulo aliases.
